featured_reviews.name: Ankit Vishwakarma
featured_reviews.review_text:
I had a very bad experience at Hot Plate Fast Food. I ordered Manchurian rice with gravy, but the food was completely unacceptable.

First of all, the rice smelled very bad, like it was old or spoiled. It felt as if the rice had been stored for days and then reused. The taste was terrible — honestly, I’ve had much better food even from roadside stalls.

Secondly, I ordered Manchurian rice, but there was not even a single proper Manchurian piece in it. The Manchurian balls in the gravy were undercooked and tasted raw (you can clearly see it in the image).

Also, while I was there, I saw other customers complaining:
Someone ordered a cheese frankie but didn’t get any cheese.
Another person got a burger that was completely cold, like it was taken straight out of the fridge and served without heating.
The overall food quality, hygiene, and service are extremely poor. This place seriously needs to improve its standards.

Worst fried rice I have ever had. I would not recommend this place to anyone.

featured_reviews.name: Mrunal Mahadik
featured_reviews.review_text:
I visited this restaurant with high expectations, but unfortunately, the overall experience was extremely disappointing due to the poor service.
We placed an order for Masala Papad, Spring Roll, and Cheese Ball Dry at 8:48 PM. Despite multiple reminders, the Masala Papad was served only at 9:21 PM. Waiting over 30 minutes for a simple Masala Papad was already concerning, especially when the restaurant was not particularly busy.
The Cheese Ball Dry arrived at 9:45 PM, nearly an hour after ordering. Later, we ordered Khoya Kaju and 3 Rotis, which were served at 10:02 PM. We specifically requested that the curry not be sweet, and the staff assured us it would be prepared spicy.
Meanwhile, we kept following up regarding the Spring Roll, which had still not arrived. To our surprise, we were informed that the order had never been communicated to the kitchen. It was difficult to believe that after nearly an hour, such a basic oversight had occurred.
What made the situation worse was the staff's response. Instead of apologizing, a service staff member casually suggested cancelling the Spring Roll order and was smiling while doing so. There seemed to be little concern for the inconvenience caused or respect for the customer's time.
As we were about to settle the bill, the Spring Roll finally arrived at 10:30 PM—almost 1 hour and 45 minutes after the order was placed. By then, it was too late to make up for the poor experience.
The food may have been acceptable, but the service was among the worst I have experienced. Excessive delays, poor communication, lack of coordination with the kitchen, and an indifferent attitude towards customers made the entire visit frustrating.
I would not recommend this place based on my experience. The management seriously needs to improve its service standards and customer handling.
